title: S3 block store backend
description:
Implement S3-compatible object storage as a selectable block store backend.

Why this issue exists:
Operators running in cloud environments (AWS, Backblaze, MinIO) need to store article blocks in object storage instead of a local IPFS node. This is the S3 implementation of the pluggable backend trait.

What needs to be done:
- Evaluate object_store vs aws-sdk-s3, implement S3Store using chosen crate
- S3ManifestWriter, startup bucket check, and config section
- Lifecycle tagging GC mode and explicit delete mode
- MinIO docker-compose integration test and RUNBOOK
